"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence":"We believe that this savage repression is motivated by the panic of local government authorities occasioned by the growth of unofficial protests and strikes by migrant workers in the Guangdong province who are suffering from the closures or relocations of their workplaces."},

{"claim_text":"The authorities appear to be trying to deprive workers of their right to any kind of support or representation by jailing those who have offered them legal support and advice.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence":"Rather than addressing the underlying problems, the authorities appear to be trying to deprive workers of their right to any kind of support or representation by jailing those who have offered them legal support and advice."}],
